name: Otoko Miko ~Ma o Shizumeru wa Uruwashiki Otome~
original_name: おとこみこ ～魔を鎮めるは麗しき男娘～
source:
The protagonist, Kazama Yukiya, was living a student life while earning money through his own method of exorcism and purification, in addition to receiving financial support from his parents. One day, men in black suits appeared at his place and forcibly took him back to the countryside. They were the messengers of the "main family", and Yukiya is informed by the head of the Kazama family at the mansion where he was taken that Hisame, a shrine priest he had adored like a real brother since he was young, has passed away.

Astonished, Yukiya is immediately told by the family head, "Become the shrine chief to protect the company and take on 'a certain troublesome matter' with the shrine maidens. You have the talent for it." Confused, Yukiya hears about the "troublesome matter" from the three charming shrine maidens and reluctantly accepts the task.
translation:
主人公风间幸哉一边过着学生生活，一边靠自己的驱魔净化方法赚钱，并得到父母的经济支持。有一天，黑衣男子出现在他的住处，强行把他带回了乡下。他们是“本家”的使者，有希也从被带走的宅邸中的风间家当主那里得知，他从小就像亲兄弟一样崇拜的神社神官久雨已经去世了。

惊讶之余，有希也立即被族长告知：“成为守护公司的社长，与巫女们一起解决‘某件麻烦事’。你有这方面的天赋。”困惑的雪也从三位迷人的巫女那里听到了“麻烦的事情”，不情愿地接受了任务。
